title: One row of Customers/{customer_id}/filings/presentations/guidance.jsonl
description: One forward-looking statement by management on an earnings call, with how it changed from the previous quarter. The eight required fields are the contract; optional fields make next quarter's comparison computable. Length bounds, the withdrawn rule and duplicate checks are in scripts/validate_guidance.py.

period.description: The quarter whose earnings call this is.

subtopic.description: Separates two statements under one topic so they can be matched next quarter, e.g. spread vs nim under spread_nim, gnpa vs collection_efficiency under asset_quality.

statement.description: Management's words, quoted from the transcript (no paraphrase). For a withdrawn row: the words used when declining, or the fixed sentence 'No statement on this topic in the <period> call.'

speaker.description: Name as printed in the transcript, with designation when the transcript gives it. null only on a withdrawn row where nobody spoke to the topic.

page.description: 1-based transcript page. null only on a withdrawn row where nobody spoke to the topic.

horizon.description: What the guidance is for, as said: 'FY26', 'next two quarters', 'medium term'.
